race.comment: This race has taken a hit from scratchings. It leaves us with ZANE ZENA (8) on top. She resumes from a spell after finishing fifth over 1500m at Caulfield Heath at the latest appearance on April 29. Can be an improver this time around and looks a key chance. SNITZEL TYCOON (12) is knocking on the door with two runner-up finishes in a row. She'll be rock-hard fit and hard to run down with the 2kg apprentice onboard. VENDORS VISION (10) is a Vadamos gelding on debut for the Patrick Payne yard. Drawn wide and has mixed jumpout form but must respect the Payne/Egan combination. ALPHA MENSAE (9) is an All Too Hard gelding on debut for the Weeding yard who draws well and can figure.
